clue.text: Reacted to foul play in game, having initiated trick

clue.text: Redesigned patterns for part of church

parts.note: taken as written

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Enlist and begin fighting

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to hire or take on someone's services

clue.text: Wrongly advises girl about heavy metal

clue.text: Backed up attempt, being assertive

parts.note: taken as written
